mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% (25th percentile of historical values).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.5% signals accelerating inflation, triggering Fed rate hikes and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 12-month moving averages indicates robust consumer and business spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS and HOUST above 12-month moving averages fails to predict positive returns in more than 55% of cases (returns negative/flat >55%).

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), labor market weakness triggers aggressive Fed easing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (INDPRO < 100) signals economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained GDP growth (GDPC1) above its 4-quarter moving average indicates strong economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds the 4-quarter moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in unemployment rate below 3.5% (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals tight labor market conditions, prompting Fed rate hikes and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE falls below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL and high FEDFUNDS (above 4.5%) indicates monetary tightening cycle, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL rising and FEDFUNDS above 4.5% fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases (returns positive/flat >55%).
